description: This Java class 'GenericHelperFactory' provides a factory method to create and cache instances of 'GenericHelper' based on configuration data. It uses reflection to load helper classes dynamically and manages a cache to optimize helper retrieval.

classes.name: GenericHelperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and caching 'GenericHelper' instances using reflection and configuration data.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a 'GenericHelper' instance based on 'GenericHelperInfo', utilizing caching and reflection to load helper classes dynamically.
